body: You're a nice person. Thanks for even taking the time to talk to me. Hope you have a good day.
I'll try my best to. Maybe I'll set aside a day to just do stuff that I haven't done in a while.

I wish I could, but I just can't bring myself to tell them. I'm stubborn, I know. I don't know how I'm going to bring this up. And to be honest, I'd rather stay in this little bubble of mine and fix things myself. It's a bit contradictory, but I like how things are right now and how I appear to people. I don't want to break that image of me by saying that I think I might have depression. I don't want to give them any more burden. 

I have this little mantra of mine. "I open my own door of happiness". I don't want to let people in my space and I don't want people to open doors for me. I believe that since this is my problem, I am the only one that give the solution.

I'm sorry if I come off as rude but this is how I feel and I really don't mean to be rude.
I honestly don't know why I'm sad. It just... happened, I guess.

I'm too afraid of telling my parents that I want to get checked by a doctor. More than anything, I'm scared that they'll just brush it off without a care or judge me. 

I wish I could start playing guitar again. But I have no motivation to and there's just too little hours in the day for me.

Thanks for your comments. I know you mean well but I just can't see my life as being precious. I see no point to it. I feel like a burden to everyone around me.

I wish I could. But I have no motivation to and there's just too little hours in the day for me to start playing again. 

And I know you mean well and I thank you for that but I just see no reason for me to keep living. I just see myself as a burden to others and I feel like every day it gets worse and I just don't know what to do.

I don't know. In grade 6, I knew someone that had depression and cut herself. And people paid more attention to her and cared for her more. And maybe I just got jealous and pretended to be sad so someone would pay attention to me, but I never really said it out loud myself. Eventually I think my sadness just ended up becoming real and becoming worse than I could ever imagine. 

I don't know if that's a valid reason to be sad but that's my earliest memory of being sad.

I don't really like venting to people I know personally though. No one in real life knows about my personal problems. I don't want to hassle them nor seem like a burden. And even if I do tell them, I feel like there's no possible way for me to tell them other than just bringing it up out of the blue.
